# Requirements Quality Checklist: Product Detail Page

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurable quality of the product-detail requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [../spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the complete product details intended for this page explicitly enumerated, including any details implied by “all details”? [Clarity, Spec §Input, §Story 1, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are image asset behavior, image alternatives, and fallback requirements specified for both the main product and related product cards? [Completeness, Spec §Story 1, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK003 Are loading, not-found, unavailable, and service-error states each given distinct requirements and recovery destinations? [Coverage, Spec §Story 1, §FR-005, §FR-009–010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the shared cart quantity/badge and checkout continuity expectations defined for detail-page cart mutations? [Completeness, Spec §Story 2, §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Are category display, availability meaning, price formatting/currency, and product-description length or formatting expectations clear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Are “relevant” related products and any maximum/result ordering criteria sufficiently specified? [Clarity, Spec §Story 3, §FR-006–008]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the intended behavior for an unavailable product distinguished from an archived/unknown product? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Are desktop two-column proportions and mobile stacking/ordering criteria objectively understandable? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the two-column desktop requirement and narrow-screen responsive behavior aligned across user stories, FRs, and accessibility requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Story 1, §FR-001, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 Are “Add one unit,” repeat-add quantity behavior, and shared cart display consistent across acceptance scenarios and functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Story 2, §FR-003–004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the related-product omission rule consistent with unavailable-product exclusion and fallback behavior when recommendation data fails? [Consistency, Spec §Story 3, §Edge Cases, §FR-006–008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Are the 10-second information-discovery and 15-second add-to-cart targets defined with a repeatable start/end event and participant method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–002]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the 90% acceptance/usability targets tied to clear sample sizes, device viewport, and task-completion definitions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are state changes between page render and add action covered, including a product becoming unavailable or its price changing? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Are recovery requirements defined for catalog timeout, cart outage, image failure, empty recommendations, and successful mutation with delayed response? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK016 Are repeat-add, concurrent-add, and cart quantity synchronization expectations specified without duplicate or lost increments? [Coverage, Spec §Story 2, §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are image alternative-text rules and accessible status announcements specified for unavailable, pending, success, and error states? [Coverage, Spec §Accessibility Requirements]
- [ ] CHK018 Are responsive viewport/breakpoint expectations and focus behavior specified for product action and related-product navigation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §Accessibility Requirements]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Ambiguities

- [ ] CHK019 Are Catalog ownership, related-product source, Cart persistence, and availability revalidation dependencies documented consistently with adjacent storefront features? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the selected same-category related-product rule explicitly validated as the intended relevance policy for the MVP? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
